segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ אֵין נִמְנִין עַל הַבְּהֵמָה לְכַתְּחִלָּה בְּיוֹם טוֹב. אֲבָל נִמְנִין עָלֶיהָ מֵעֶרֶב יוֹם טוֹב, וְשׁוֹחֲטִין וּמְחַלְּקִין בֵּינֵיהֶם.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One» may «not register» to have a portion «of an animal on a Festival ab initio,» since it is prohibited to divide up an animal into portions for different people, as this is similar to conducting business, a weekday activity, on a Festival. «But one» may «register for» the animal «on the eve of the Festival, and» then those who registered for the animal may «slaughter and divide» it «between them» on the Festival itself in accordance with the agreement reached the day before. The next day, each pays the slaughterer according to his portion of the animal.

moves.summary: no registering on the Festival; permitted from the eve

positions.claim: one may not register for an animal on a Festival ab initio, but may register on the eve and divide on the Festival
